subject: Private deployment security discovery: network isolation, SOC 2 status, and air-gapped options
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@medspire.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T22:10:00Z
Subject: Private deployment discovery — quick recap and next asks

Alex — thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Summary from call:
- Use case: med imaging indexing + clinical summarization for internal clinicians (no patient-facing UI).
- Data residency requirement: US only.
- Compliance: MedSpire is evaluating both HIPAA/BAA requirements and GDPR applicability for EU-sourced records.
- Preferred deployment: private VPC in customer cloud or on-prem airgapped if required for certain clusters.

Open items / action requests (we need these to scope Private deployment):
1) SOC 2 status: please confirm current Type (I/II) and if Type II audit is scheduled (expected date).
2) Procurement: provide any required procurement/legal contacts and standard timelines.
3) Network topology: can you share a concise network diagram showing where workloads would live (subnets, NAT/Bastion, egress controls)?
4) Data flow: enumerate where artifacts (models/checkpoints, telemetry, logs) may be stored and whether S3 or equivalent is allowed outbound.
5) Airgap ask: is fully air-gapped on-prem deployment required for PHI data, or would a VPC with strict egress controls suffice?

Attachments: redwood_private_overview.pdf (product brief), vendor_questionnaire_template.docx (initial security RFI) — see attached stubs.

Proposed next steps:
- Alex shares SOC 2 status + network topology PDF by EOD Thu (10/07).
- We run the questionnaire in parallel; Jordan to coordinate legal + procurement introduction once we have contacts.
- Technical deep-dive (30–45m) with Neha and Mina next week to walk through segmentation and access models.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@medspire.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, MedSpire Security <security@medspire.com>, procurement@medspire.com
Date: 2027-10-04T01:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Private deployment discovery — quick recap and next asks

Jordan — appreciate the clear notes. Follow-ups inline and attaching a draft topology: MSP_network_topology_v2.pdf.

SOC 2 / Compliance:
- Current: SOC 2 Type I (controls mapped) completed July 2026.
- Type II: audit engagement scheduled, expected completion window Q2 2028 (tentative — auditors finalizing scope).
- HIPAA: Yes, we have an existing BAA program for our clinical integrations.
- GDPR: We process some EU-sourced records via a dedicated EU tenant; will need confirmation on data residency for specific workloads.

Network / Airgap:
- Attached topology shows our current cloud-hosted deployment and an on-prem option sketch (see page 2).
- For PHI workloads, procurement prefers VPC with egress restrictions to a controlled S3 endpoint and KMS in customer account. Fully air-gapped on-prem is acceptable but procurement will require an extended procurement window and capital approval.

Procurement / timeline:
- Procurement contact: procurement@medspire.com (cc'd). Internal procurement lead will need vendor questionnaire + pricing + SOC 2 evidence.
- Targeting selection decision by end of Q1 2028.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll share a cleaned network diagram and any existing SOC artefacts we can disclose by Friday (10/08).
- Agree on technical deep-dive — Thurs or Fri next week are best.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Carter
Director, Product Integrations | MedSpire Health
alex.carter@medspire.com | +1 (617) 444-2266

Attachment: MSP_network_topology_v2.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@medspire.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-04T04:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Private deployment discovery — technical clarifications before deep-dive

Alex — thanks, that topology is helpful. A few targeted clarifications so we prepare the right architecture options for the deep-dive: 

1) Egress controls:
- Do you require egress to the public internet at all for the private deployment? If so, which external destinations are permitted (e.g., monitoring SaaS, backup to S3 in customer account, telemetry endpoints)?

2) Key management:
- Will you provide a customer-managed KMS/HSM for encryption keys (preferred), or must Redwood manage keys?

3) KV cache / model artifacts:
- For on-prem airgapped installs we typically mount model artifacts from a local registry. Do you have an internal artifact registry or will we stage models onto airgapped media?

4) Administrative access model:
- Do you want Redwoods ops access during onboarding (time boxed with Just-In-Time) or zero vendor access with customer-run ops?

5) Audit evidence:
- For procurement: which documents are highest priority — SOC 2 report, pen test report, dataflow diagrams, BAA template? We will prepare a prioritized bundle.

I also posted the initial vendor questionnaire link: https://redwood.ai/security/questionnaire?init=medspire-1423 — it pre-populates several items for faster completion. Please confirm who on your side will own this (security or procurement).

If you can answer the egress + KMS questions ahead of the deep-dive, we can sketch both a VPC-with-egress-lockdown and an on-prem airgapped option to show tradeoffs (latency, ops overhead, procurement risk).

-Neha

Neha Kapoor
Security Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0121

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@medspire.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-04T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Private deployment discovery — network isolation, SOC 2 status, and air-gapped options

Alex — thanks for the fast turnaround and the topology PDF. Two quick administrative items and proposed timeline so procurement has clarity: 

Action items we will take on (Redwood):
- Neha to prepare two architecture sketches: (A) VPC private deployment with customer-managed KMS + egress-locked S3; (B) on-prem airgapped installation runbook (including artifact staging). Deliverable by Fri 10/08.
- Rishi will assemble a prioritized evidence bundle: SOC 2 summary, pen test summary, BAA template, and the vendor_questionnaire_template pre-filled with our answers. Deliverable by Tue 10/12.
- Jordan to introduce procurement contact in HubSpot and kick off pricing conversation once questionnaire status is clear.

Requests for MedSpire (Alex / procurement team):
- Confirm whether egress to monitoring endpoints (e.g., Datadog) is allowed or must be routed through customer-managed collectors.
- Confirm if customer-managed KMS is required for all PHI workloads.
- Assign owner for the initial vendor questionnaire (security or procurement).

Proposed timeline (aligned to your Q1 decision window):
- 10/08: Redwood architecture sketches delivered to MedSpire security.
- 10/12: Redwood evidence bundle and pre-filled questionnaire provided.
- 10/14–10/18: Technical deep-dive session (booked via Calendly — link in HubSpot).

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/RDW-2027-MED-1423 (Jordan will add procurement contact).

If this looks good I will lock the above deliverables and calendar the deep-dive.

Best — Mina
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
